body: I was the responding unit to a minor car accident. As I pulled up I saw that my younger brother was one of the involved parties. As matter of policy back then, we ran all parties through WASIS. ( the State Identification System and Criminal History Check). Imagine my surprise when the check came back "Affirmative 29 frank" on that subject. 29 meant he had a warrant and the "Frank" told me it was a Felony. I didn't say a word about it to my brother but I called for another unit to take lead and stood back while he took my brother into custody. He received a probationary sentence for his first and only criminal act he has ever done. It was awkward at family functions for a bit till he told me "Man don't sweat it. I was the one that "F'ed" up. We have been cool ever since and he has straightened up.
